labels.description: Adds a new disintermediation risk that payments industry participants may withhold rights to data Mastercard uses to power its solutions, in order to support their own future solutions, potentially impairing the effectiveness of Mastercard's solutions.

labels.rationale: minor: stylistic rewording with identical meaning plus page-footer residue; no change in risk, scope or numbers.

labels.description: Broadens the listed technological change from "cryptocurrency and blockchain" to "digital assets and blockchain", adds that third parties Mastercard relies on may fail to keep pace with technological change "including with regard to AI", and trims "safety and security technologies" to "security technologies".
labels.rationale: criterion 3: scope widened (cryptocurrency to the broader category of digital assets) and the third-party dependency risk is newly extended to AI specifically.
